verdicts.reason: A: clear centred hierarchy (headline, then CTA), but the FIZZBANG! logo is shrunk to a near-illegible chip, the white panel runs full height and swallows most of the pop-art shapes, and the left circle and quarter-circle are clipped. B: the logo badge is dumped on top of the pink circle, navy shape and yellow stripe (an unwanted collision), the headline breaks with an orphaned 'can', and the CTA floats off to the right, away from the copy, so the layout looks scattered rather than designed.
